items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 26 at 3:19PM EST until November 27 at 1:00PM EST by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 12
to 20 feet expected in the surf zone. For the Coastal Flood
Warning, 2 to 3 feet or more of inundation above ground level
expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways.

* WHERE...Coastal Worcester County, including Ocean City.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Warning, until 7 PM EST Friday.
For the High Surf Advisory, until 1 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Moderate to Major flooding is occurring and will
continue to result in extensive inundation. Water will be 2 to
3 feet or more above ground level in flooded areas. Numerous
homes and businesses could be flooded. Many roads across the
area may become impassable for an extended period of time
causing many neighborhoods to become flooded and isolated.
Life threatening flooding may extend well inland from the
waterfront and shoreline. Should evacuations become necessary,
follow the advice of local officials for evacuation
information.
items.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.

Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

items.headline: Flood Warning issued November 26 at 2:21PM EST until November 26 at 8:00PM EST by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Urban areas and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Dorchester County in southeastern Maryland...
Somerset County in southeastern Maryland...
Wicomico County in southeastern Maryland...
Worcester County in southeastern Maryland...
Accomack County in southeastern Virginia...

* WHEN...Until 800 PM EST.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, roads, and other
low-lying and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 221 PM EST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain. Flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly in the warned area. Between
2 and 4 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are possible in the
warned area through 4 PM.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Salisbury, Cambridge, Ocean City, Fruitland, Pocomoke City,
Princess Anne, Hurlock, Exmore, University Of Maryland Eastern
Shore, Salisbury University, Berlin, Delmar, Snow Hill, Onancock,
Hebron, Parksley, Secretary, Onley, Vienna and Westover.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
items.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

items.headline: Storm Warning issued November 26 at 2:47PM EST until November 26 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 35 to 45 kt with gusts up to 55 kt and seas 18
to 28 ft expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Fenwick Island DE to Chincoteague
VA out 20 NM and Waters from Fenwick Island DE to Chintoteague
VA from 20 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM EST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Storm force winds and hazardous seas will capsize or
damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should remain in port, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for severe conditions.
